If daily application is challenging, single-dose film-forming terbinafine products can be effective, provided reinfection sources are controlled [0]. In summary, fungal creams do work for athlete’s foot, but they are most effective when used correctly and combined with prevention and environmental control strategies rather than relied upon alone [0, 1].
